items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: easy to record all of different type of numbers than with Charlie Parker

ctx.x: Ehh - maybe he was Italian and the Italian has something in common with Spanish and he was, in a way, easy to record all of different type of numbers than with Charlie Parker.
I agree with you. Listening to those recordings, Flip was more melodic and more in tune with the Cuban music than Charlie Parker was.
